title: iCloud Documents (15m) sync stale (no successful run in 4h)

annotations.description: Mac Studio's `~/bin/rclone-documents-sync.sh` (Documents → Nextcloud, every 15 min) heartbeats events to Loki. Each run takes 60-90 min so most timer fires bail with `locked` — but at least one run should complete every ~2h. Zero `idle`/`uploaded` events for 4h means rclone is stuck, Nextcloud is unreachable, or the script is broken. Check `~/Library/Logs/rclone-documents-sync-ongoing.log`, `pgrep -fl rclone-documents-sync`, lockfile state. Dashboard: /d/immich-sync/icloud-synchronisation
annotations.summary: iCloud Documents 15-min sync stale: zero successful runs in 4 hours
